message.content:
Sure! In Python you can split on the first occurrence of `"="` by passing a maximum split count of 1:

```python
temp = "hello=good="
parts = temp.split('=', 1)   # split only once
print(parts)                # ['hello', 'good=']
```

`parts` will contain exactly `["hello", "good="]`.
